text:
maya: Morning — quick async standup re: CedarGen surge + renewal risk. TL;DR: they saw ~5x webhook retries overnight, renewal due EOM and CS flagged this as a churn risk.

maya: What I did: opened ticket with infra, grabbed rotating logs from us-east, notified eng.

maya: Blockers: logs miss a correlation_id for some retries so tracing the exact code path is tricky. Also customer is on shared routing so capacity/burst might be hitting rate limits.

maya: Today: coordinate with eng for a temporary routing override to Dedicated tier, prepare customer note, and ping billing for renewal touch.

sara: saw the alerts too. 503 bursts clustered between 02:10-02:30 UTC. uploaded sample payloads to the ticket. :eyes:

raj: I've booked the renewal call for Friday 3pm PT. Need an ETA on a mitigation so I can update execs.

oliver: @maya can you drop a sample request id in thread? my hunch is rate-limiter + prefix-caching combo under burst. i'll start digging into 02:10 window. pinged @kevin for routing toggle.

kevin: I can flip routing to Dedicated for CedarGen for a short window to validate. Need 1-line approval from CS to proceed. I'll also enable kvcache debug for 30m.

kevin: Command I'll run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/ops/routing \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer":"cedargen","route":"dedicated","duration":"2h"}'
```

maya: Approve — please proceed when ready. Also opened a tiny PR to add correlation_id to incoming webhook logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3241 — might need a quick review.

oliver: on it, will review in ~30m. if urgent i can merge behind a qa-flag.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for route toggle started at 2026-03-17T09:12:02Z (10% traffic -> Dedicated).

sara: I updated the customer to say we may temporarily route them to Dedicated to stabilize while we investigate. they appreciated the quick heads-up.

maya: Follow-up: found sample req id `req_0a9f3e` in the raw logs and attached it to the ticket. flagged this account as renewal-risk in CS tracker.

kevin: Routing toggle completed at 2026-03-17T09:17:05Z. Observed error rate drop back to baseline within 90s. leaving the toggle active for now; will auto-revert in 2h unless we see regression.

raj: Thanks all — i'll confirm with the customer and keep the Friday call. looping legal for an SLA note and cc'ing renewal ops.

maya: Blocker temporarily resolved; leaving ticket open for root cause analysis. Today I'll draft a short postmortem snippet and schedule an RCA for tomorrow 11am PT. @oliver please attach any perf traces you find to the ticket.

oliver: will add traces and a perf snapshot, + quick note on potential rate-limiter threshold misconfig.

sara: great. i'll follow up on customer comms post-call. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks team, will update this thread with RCA invite and any notes from the renewal call.
